event.line: interrupted (stop command): the simulation was stopped

event.message: the launcher's controller steps every 10 ms (the default of a run that starts without a speed), but the ECUs' steps are as small as 5 ms: with a speed, the launcher keeps real time only at the controller's steps. An ECU step that starts between two of them runs at the later one, up to 5 ms after the real time it stands for (never before it), together with the other steps in between; a device attached in real time gets the messages of those steps up to 5 ms late and in a burst. Write time_step_ms: 5 (or give the speed from the start, with speed or run --speed: the default is then that)
interrupted (stop command): the launcher stopped the simulation and the participants
